• Testability assurance

questions.question: About Proliferator Exclusive Mode
questions.answer: Proliferators have two modes: "Extra Production" and "Speed Boost", but they cannot be used simultaneously (exclusive mode). When one is selected, the other is disabled.

questions.question: Belt Speed Calculation Method
questions.answer: Belt speed affects item transport speed (items/s). Speed increases in order: Mk.I, Mk.II, Mk.III.

questions.question: How Power Calculation Works
questions.answer: Total power consumption is the sum of facility power consumption and sorter power consumption. Facility power consumption varies based on machine rank and proliferator settings.

questions.question: Calculation Accuracy Limitations
questions.answer: Calculation results are theoretical values and may differ slightly from actual in-game behavior. In particular, effects such as belt congestion and sorter processing speed are not considered.

questions.question: Browser Compatibility
questions.answer: We recommend the latest versions of modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari). Internet Explorer is not supported.

questions.question: What to Do When Calculation Results Don't Match
questions.answer:
Please check the following:
1. Is the game version supported?
2. Are the settings (proliferator, machine rank, etc.) correct?
3. Is the alternative recipe selection correct?
4. Are the node-specific settings appropriate?

questions.question: How to Save and Load Plans
questions.answer: You can save plans from the "💾 Save" button in the header. Saved plans can be loaded from "📂 Load". Plans are saved in the browser's local storage.

questions.question: How to Use URL Sharing
questions.answer: From the header "💾 Save" → "🔗 URL Share", you can share your current plan via URL. When you send the generated URL to other users, they can load the plan with the same settings.

questions.question: When Data Cannot Be Loaded
questions.answer:
Please check the following:
1. Is your internet connection working?
2. Clear browser cache
3. Reload the page (Ctrl+F5 or Cmd+Shift+R)

questions.question: When Calculations Don't Run
questions.answer: Please check if a recipe is selected. Also, verify that the target production quantity is greater than 0.

questions.question: How to Read Error Messages
questions.answer: If an error message is displayed, check the error content and reload the page if necessary. If the problem persists, please report it on GitHub Issues.
